seoTitle: How to Connect Paystack to Shopify (Fix Not Showing)
metaDescription: Add Paystack as a payment gateway in Shopify with the correct API keys, and fix common issues when Paystack isn't showing up.
intro: For store owners in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, and other African markets, Paystack is often the most practical payment gateway to offer local currencies and a smooth checkout. This guide covers how to add Paystack in your Shopify payment settings, connect it correctly with API keys, and troubleshoot when it isn't appearing.

steps.heading: Open Shopify payment provider settings
steps.body: Go to your Shopify admin's payment settings and look for the option to add a third-party payment provider.

steps.heading: Add Paystack as a payment provider
steps.body: Select Paystack from the list of available providers or add it manually if it's supported as a custom gateway in your region.

steps.heading: Link your Paystack account with API keys
steps.body: Enter your Paystack API keys correctly to authenticate the connection between Paystack and your Shopify store.

steps.heading: Troubleshoot if Paystack isn't showing
steps.body: If Paystack doesn't appear as an option, confirm it's supported in your Shopify plan and region, since availability can vary by market.

steps.heading: Test a transaction
steps.body: Process a test payment to confirm Paystack is working correctly at checkout before going fully live.

faq.question: Why isn't Paystack showing up as a payment option in Shopify?
faq.answer: This is often related to regional availability or incorrect API key setup, so double-check your store's country settings and the keys you've entered.

faq.question: Do I need a Paystack business account?
faq.answer: Yes, you need an active Paystack merchant account with valid API credentials before connecting it to Shopify.

faq.question: Can I use Paystack alongside Shopify Payments?
faq.answer: Depending on your region, you may be able to offer Paystack alongside other gateways, though availability can vary by Shopify plan.

faq.question: Is Paystack good for stores outside Africa?
faq.answer: Paystack is primarily built for African markets, so it's most useful if you're targeting customers in countries like Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, or South Africa.
